meta.description: Trackt: open-source, self-hostable tracker for movies, series, anime, manga, webtoons, and games.

errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.instanceUnreachable: Couldn’t reach the instance API. Is it running? Try again in a moment.
errors.searchFailed: Search failed. Is the instance API reachable? Try again in a moment.
errors.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email to sign in.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not right. Check the email and try again.
errors.codeExpired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Send a new code.

shell.notFoundBody: That page doesn’t exist, or it never did.
shell.errorBody: The page failed to render. Try again, or head home.

verify.title: Check your inbox
verify.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits from the email.
verify.resent: A new code is on its way.
verify.noEmail: Open the link from your email, or sign in to get a new code.

auth.modesAria: Sign in or create an account

validation.usernameFormat: 3 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, dots, underscores
validation.disposableEmail: Use a permanent address: disposable and relay emails (Firefox Relay, Hide My Email…) are not accepted

hero.label: Track every movie, series, anime, manga, webtoon and game
hero.body: One log for everything you watch, read and play. Check in an episode or a chapter in two taps, see what your friends are into, and get news only about what you follow.
hero.proof: OPEN SOURCE · FULL EXPORT ANY TIME · <import>IMPORT FROM 5 APPS</import>

kinds.body: No more one app for shows, a spreadsheet for manga and a memory for games. Each kind is tracked the way it is actually consumed.

how.series: Season by season, episode by episode.
how.webtoon: Chapter by chapter, season by season.

checkIn.title: Two taps. It’s logged.
checkIn.body: Your next episode or chapter is waiting on the home page. Try it.

friends.title: Friends, minus the spoilers
friends.body: See what your people watch, read, rate and drop. Anything past where you are stays blurred until you catch up.

news.title: News you actually follow
news.body: Renewals, release dates and adaptations, filtered down to the titles in your library.
news.renewed: Neon Harbor renewed for a third season
news.premiere: Ashfall Chronicle part two premieres 9 January

profile.title: A profile that reads like you
profile.body: Your top pick in every kind, what you are into right now, and where your time really goes.

import.body: Years of watching, reading and playing already live somewhere. Import them and start with a full log instead of an empty one.
import.note: RATINGS AND DATES COME ACROSS · IMPORT MORE THAN ONE

discord.body: Add the Trackt bot to your server and the log follows your group into the channel where you already talk.

parties.v: Schedule an episode, a film or a chapter. Everyone who joins is checked in when it ends.

feed.v: Check-ins, ratings and finished titles post to the channel you choose.

commands.v: Look up a title, see what is up next, or log from chat without opening the app.

discord.over: Party over. june_k, rex, aki and noor were checked in to S2 E6. Average rating 8.8

open.title: Open by default
open.body: Years of history should not depend on one company staying alive. The code is public, your data leaves whenever you want, and anyone can run their own copy.

source.v: GPL-3.0, developed in the open on GitHub.

data.v: Full export at any time, in an open format.

api.v: Everything the app does, documented from day one.

selfHost.v: Prefer your own instance? One command:

closer.title: Start your <accent>log.</accent>
closer.body: Add the first thing you watched, read or played this week. The rest follows.
